draft.heroMessage: Wilmington’s Trusted Luxury Real Estate Expert
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to your next chapter with Melanie Cameron and The Cameron Team—helping buyers and sellers navigate Wilmington and coastal NC’s finest homes with integrity and attention to detail.
draft.tagline: Confidential. Professional. Connected in Coastal Luxury.
draft.aboutParagraph: Melanie Cameron leads The Cameron Team at Coldwell Banker Sea Coast Advantage, where luxury isn’t just a price point—it’s a standard for service. Recognized for her honesty, steady negotiating, and deep area insight, Melanie has established a reputation as one of Wilmington’s premier luxury property specialists. She combines refined market knowledge with genuine local connections, making each real estate journey rewarding and discreet. From the beaches to the golf course communities, trust Melanie to match your lifestyle and priorities while protecting your privacy.
draft.conciergeLine: Let’s talk about your goals. Schedule your confidential consultation with Melanie Cameron today.
draft.contactLine: Call 910-202-2546 to connect with Melanie or The Cameron Team.

sections.title: Melanie Cameron
sections.body: Coldwell Banker Global Luxury Specialist Melanie Cameron and The Cameron Team specialize in luxury real estate in Wilmington, NC, and the surrounding coastal areas of Southeastern North Carolina. Among her colleagues and clients, Melanie is known for her professionalism, honesty, and integrity. She aims to make every transaction as lucrative as possible for her clients and believes the best way to do that is by taking a sensible, even-keeled approach to negotiations.

sections.title: Wilmington, NC
sections.body: “I bought a home in North Carolina yesterday. Heather Lindquist-Bull was my buyers agent. sections.title: Buy With Us
sections.body: From finding a reputable lender to negotiating home repairs, we protect our buyer's best interests with years of experience and professional knowledge of our local real estate market.

sections.title: Let's Get Social!
sections.body: 🏡 More homes for sale = more negotiating power? Not always! Wilmington's housing inventory is growing, giving buyers more options. But that doesn't mean every seller is ready to make a deal! 💰 From days on market to price reductions and property condition, knowing where you have leverage can make all the difference.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.body: 110 Dungannon Blvd Ste 100, Wilmington, NC 28403 910-202-2546 [email protected]

sections.title: Compliance status
sections.body: We firmly believe that the internet should be available and accessible to anyone, and are committed to providing a website that is accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of circumstance and ability. To fulfill this, we aim to adhere as strictly as possible to the World Wide Web Consortium’s (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 (WCAG 2.1) at the AA level. These guidelines explain how to make web content accessible to people with a wide array of disabilities.

sections.title: Browser and assistive technology compatibility
sections.body: We aim to support the widest array of browsers and assistive technologies as possible, so our users can choose the best fitting tools for them, with as few limitations as possible. Therefore, we have worked very hard to be able to support all major systems that comprise over 95% of the user market share including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Opera and Microsoft Edge, JAWS and NVDA (screen readers), both for Windows and for MAC users.
